verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented data-export feature or open export format. The only exit-related evidence is indirect: an MIT-style open-source library you can self-host (orama-docs-12), on-premise deployment of Orama Cloud (orama-docs-8), and API parity meant to make migrating projects between Orama Cloud and Orama Open Source easy (orama-docs-19, orama-docs-29). Missing for 10: a documented bulk data export from Orama Cloud, named open export formats (e.g., JSON/CSV/Parquet) covering documents and embeddings, account-exit or data-portability docs, and independent corroboration that data can actually be moved out.
